content: वासना .²1 Knowledge derived from memory; <ab>cf.</ab> भावना. .²2 Particularly, the impression unconsciously left on the mind by past good or bad actions, which therefore produces pleasure or pain. .²3 Fancy, imagination, idea. .²4 False idea, ignorance. .²5 A wish, desire, expectation, inclination; संसारवासनाबद्धशृङ्खला <ls>Gīt. 3</ls>. .²6 Regard, liking, respectful regard; तेषां (पक्षिणां) मध्ये मम तु महती वासना चातकेषु <ls>Bv. 4. 17</ls>. .²7 Perfuming, scenting. .²8 (In <ab>math.</ab>) Proof, demonstration.
